name: Point Leo
intro: Point Leo is a beach, a surf break, and one of the most ambitious privately held sculpture parks in the country  -  and almost nothing else. The village barely qualifies as a village  -  a foreshore camping ground, a surf life-saving club, a quiet residential pocket  -  but pull off the road into Point Leo Estate and you find sixteen hectares of contemporary sculpture rolling toward the bay, a hatted dining room with one of the great Australian wine lists, and a cellar door that takes itself only as seriously as it should. The break out front is the Peninsula's most consistent right-hander, and the longboard contest that turns up here each year is the real local calendar. People come to Point Leo for a quiet morning at the beach, an unhurried afternoon among the sculptures, and a long dinner with a Pinot Noir flight. That sequence is the entire reason to come.
factualLede: Point Leo is a small coastal locality on the Mornington Peninsula's Western Port coast, 85 km from Melbourne, anchored by a long-standing surf break, the Point Leo Foreshore Reserve camp ground and Point Leo Estate's sculpture park, restaurant and cellar door.

heroImage.alt: Contemporary sculptures set among coastal grasses at Point Leo Estate, looking toward Western Port

tldr: Point Leo is two things — one of the Peninsula's most consistent surf breaks, and Point Leo Estate's hatted restaurant, cellar door and 16-hectare sculpture park.
Best for: art lovers; surfers; serious food-and-wine visitors who want a single-stop day.
Signature experience: morning walk through the sculptures, lunch on the Estate verandah, afternoon at the break.
A full day even if you skip dinner; pair it with Shoreham or Flinders for a weekend.
The foreshore camping ground is among the Peninsula's best for beach-front sites.
notFor: people wanting a village to walk
first-time Peninsula visitors with one day
stayDuration: a full day, or a night on the foreshore
signature: Sixteen hectares of contemporary sculpture rolling toward Western Port — and one of the Peninsula's quietest surf breaks out front.
skip: Treating Point Leo Estate as just lunch — the sculpture park is the reason to be here.
bestDay: Walk the sculpture park on opening, long lunch at the Estate restaurant, afternoon surf check or beach walk, sunset cellar-door flight before driving on.
insiderNote: The Estate is open from 11 — arrive before opening to park easily and to have the first hour of the sculpture park almost to yourself.
